column1: # The satellite replica manifest (spec 057, owner topic 5fe56859): every tool
# the box PC's agent user runs, the command that prints its version, and the
# action that installs it on the satellite. do_satellite_verify reads this
# file: it runs each command on THIS box and on the satellite and prints both
# versions; a tool missing on the satellite is a FAIL.
# Columns, TAB separated: name  version-command  installed-by
